laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The part after 'en' has no verb of its own (it is elliptical), so under the AWS 2017 rule given there is no comma before 'en'; the protected words after it are untouched.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The second clause has its own subject (Langa) with the verb gapped, so the comma marks the contrast between the two people and is acceptable; removing it puts two 'en's close together ('aktivis en skrywer gedoen en Langa') and makes a first reading harder, not easier.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'bly' suggests choosing to stay; 'aangehou word' is the precise verb for being held, and matches 'sonder verhoor aangehou' in the study text.
na_skrywer.fout: 'bly' does not say the person is held there against their will, so the entry read on its own could suggest a choice to stay alone.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is real, but this is a [begrip] definition, the proposal adds meaning (being held by someone) and costs a word in a lesson at its ceiling, so the writer must decide the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Sy het in daardie jare van buite die regering aan 'n vryer land gewerk. Haar stryd het lank voor daardie jaar begin.
vlae.rede: 'daardie jaar' (1956) comes straight after 'daardie jare', so a learner may not know which year is meant; the second sentence is protected, so this is flagged, not changed.

vlae.teks: Hulle het in die hof teen die nuwe staat se eie onwettige uitsettings gewen.
vlae.rede: One wins against a party or wins a case, not 'against evictions'; slightly unidiomatic, but any fix touches a protected wording, so it is flagged only.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: die nuwe staat se eie uitsettings
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This protected wording does not occur verbatim in the lesson, which reads 'die nuwe staat se eie onwettige uitsettings'; the entry may need updating so the guard matches the text.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Pius Langa se pad deur die howe
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Van daar het hy stap vir stap landdros geword
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Daarvandaan het hy stap vir stap tot landdros opgeklim
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Daarvandaan' is the natural form, and 'stap vir stap' collocates with rising to a post ('tot ... opgeklim') rather than with 'geword'; same word count, meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Van daar het hy stap vir stap landdros geword' already reads well; the proposal is a lateral rewording that adds a word to a lesson near its ceiling.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Veldtog' is a countable noun and needs an article or plural (''n veldtog voer' / 'veldtogte voer').
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Veldtog voer' is an established Afrikaans verb phrase (like 'oorlog voer'), so this is not a plain grammar error and a glossary definition should not be reworded for it.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Freedom is 'ingeperk' (restricted); 'ingekort' means shortened and is the wrong collocation.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Iemand se vryheid inkort' is standard Afrikaans for restricting freedom, so swapping to 'ingeperk' is a lateral move inside a glossary definition.
